title: Petrwolf's smoke generator
description: Add a placeable smoke generator block to create adjustable white or black chimney smoke with multiple intensity levels.
body:
# Smoke Generator

## Bring your Minecraft builds to life with realistic chimney smoke.

Smoke Generator is a simple decorative block that can be placed on top of any structure you want to use as a chimney. Whether you’re building a small cottage, a factory, a steam locomotive, or an industrial power plant, you can easily add animated smoke without using redstone or complex contraptions.

## Features

* Place the Smoke Generator on top of any block.
* Perfect for chimneys, furnaces, factories, locomotives, ships, and industrial buildings.
* Right-click the block to cycle through smoke modes.
* Choose between:
    * White Smoke - Low
    * White Smoke - Medium
    * White Smoke - High
    * Black Smoke - Low
    * Black Smoke - Medium
    * Black Smoke - High
* Instant visual changes with a single click.
* Lightweight and easy to use.
* Fully survival-friendly.

## How It Works

1. Place the Smoke Generator where your chimney ends.
2. Right-click the block.
3. Select the smoke color and intensity you want.
4. Enjoy a more dynamic and realistic build.

## Perfect For

* Houses and cottages
* Steam trains
* Factories
* Power plants
* Ships
* Medieval villages
* Industrial cities
* Custom adventure maps

Smoke Generator is designed to stay simple. No complicated setup, no wiring, just place it, choose your smoke, and make your builds feel alive.
